events.title: GPT-3 API announced
events.summary: A large language model good enough to feel like a product category, not just a research demo.

narrative.whyChosen: GPT-3 was the moment many developers first felt general-purpose text generation could be productized.
narrative.whyImportant: It kicked off the modern LLM app wave: copilots, prompt engineering, fine-tuning services, and API-first AI products.
narrative.problemSolved: Language tasks previously needed custom models or brittle rules. One general model could handle many tasks with prompts.

media.title: AI hype cycle meme culture
media.caption: Public reaction quickly split between amazement, skepticism, and joke formats.
